translations.web: “Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
translations.bsb: “Your words against Me have been harsh,” says the LORD. “Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’
translations.kjv: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken
translations.asv: Your words have been stout against me, saith Jehovah. Yet ye say, What have we spoken against thee?
